rationale: C01 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses nearly the same two-recital sequence, distinctive public-interest formulation, operative restoration to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii, and Hawaii-specific survey-description machinery as the child. C02 and C11 are also close restoration precedents, but C01 most closely matches the child’s plural parcels, prior military reservation orders, Oahu setting, and operative phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS certain lands on the Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, were reserved for military purposes by Executive Order ... as modified by ...; and
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS certain lands in ... Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, were reserved for military purposes by Executive order ... as modified by ...; and
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel recital identifying Oahu military lands reserved by an earlier order and modified by a sequence of later directives.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS the hereinafter-described parcels of such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS the hereinafter-described parcels of such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Essentially verbatim and unusually specific shared recital.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described parcels of land comprising portions of the Fort Ruger Military Reservation ... are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following parcels of land comprising a part of the Schofield Barracks Military Reservation and the Wheeler Field Military Reservation ... are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Same operative machinery, with the military reservation names and scope adapted.
